scope: Tested context boundaries, not an exhaustive builtin or grammar specification

ordinary_function.values: finite f64, bool, string, null, lists and runtime handles
ordinary_function.validation: parsing does not resolve every runtime call

editor.validation: balanced structure with recovery; does not enforce edition, call validity or tensor semantics

slicing.ordinary: lists; runtime integer endpoints; empty allowed
slicing.tensor: 1D f32; compile-time numeric endpoints; empty rejected

categorical_vectors.normalization: logits stable softmax subtracts maximum; probabilities validate and preserve values
categorical_vectors.metadata: runtime values and model/optimizer-checkpoint output contracts; missing artifact field defaults to f32
categorical_vectors.gradient: softmax VJP for logits; identity for validated probabilities

categorical_sampling.model: local model handle variable or function parameter
categorical_sampling.input: one expression evaluated once; finite f32 vector matching model input
categorical_sampling.output: zero-based categorical index; explicit logits stable softmax, probabilities validate and sample actual mass, legacy f32 retains logits interpretation
categorical_sampling.rng: one script RNG draw per successful sample
